apps.subtitle: PlayStation 2 emulator for ARM64
apps.localizedDescription: A free and open-source PlayStation 2 (PS2) emulator based on PCSX2, with native ARM64 JIT recompilers. Play PS2 games on your phone, PC, or gaming handheld.

versions.localizedDescription:
Automated nightly build for community testing (unsigned).

Every download is named `ARMSX2-nightly-DATE-COMMIT-PLATFORM`, so builds
from different nights stay distinguishable after you have downloaded them.

- macOS arm64: macOS-arm64.tar.xz
- Linux arm64: Linux-arm64.AppImage, for 4K, 16K and 64K page kernels alike
- Windows arm64: Windows-arm64.zip
- RetroArch on Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-libretro-core.tar.zst
- Bare-display kmsdrm handhelds: Linux-arm64-SDL-handheld.tar.zst (Rocknix and Batocera run compositors, so use the Qt AppImage there instead)
- Android: Android-arm64.apk (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)
- iOS: iOS-arm64.ipa, unsigned, sideload it (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)

Coming from an old nightly? Nightlies are now a separate app, ARMSX2 Nightly, next to stable.

- Android: stable cannot install over an old nightly. Back up your saves and memory cards, uninstall the old nightly, then install the stable APK.
- iOS: your old nightly is the ARMSX2 iOS app and still has your saves. Copy them into ARMSX2 Nightly with the Files app.

## What's new
- Android: describe what applyPadButton does with p_range
- Android: drop unchanged USB pad reports on the reader thread
- Android: rumble for a DualShock 3 under the USB takeover
- Android: keep a DualShock 3 button pressed while its pressure reads 0
- Android: native DualShock 3 button pressure over USB
- Linux arm64: pad shared structures to 128 bytes, warn only on a smaller line
- tests: drop host_page_test, its tests already run in common_test and recompiler_tests
- Linux arm64: detect host page geometry at runtime
- iOS: stop SettingsStore's init from starting GameSession
- iOS: move the DEV9 settings into SettingsStore.Network
- iOS: move the controller settings into SettingsStore.Controller
- iOS: move the appearance preferences into SettingsStore.Appearance
- iOS: make the setting descriptors static tables in their domain files
- iOS: move the types and ranges out of SettingsStore.swift
- iOS: stop three background flags rewriting themselves at launch
- GameDB: VU1 clamp mode Extra for Tales of Destiny
- GS/Vulkan: run program off on Qualcomm's driver
- Comments: drop pointers to notes that are not in this tree
- eerunner: --gamedb runs a no-disc savestate under a game's serial and CRC
- eerunner: --dump-config loads --savestate first
- eerunner: --nodisc boots with the tray empty and loads the savestate
- Android: remove the live GS apply queue, which nothing calls
- Android: queue settings applies on the CPU thread instead of waiting for them
- Android: drop a trigger's duplicate key event whenever its axis moves (#674)
- arm64: drop the blank line at the end of BaseblockEx-arm64.h
- gsrunner: -panvk-bifrost puts PanVK's Bifrost paths on any Vulkan device
- GS/Vulkan: neither load nor store a stencil-one temporary on PanVK with a Bifrost GPU
- GS: keep stencil-one DATE on a temporary when its primitives overlap
- GS: DATE without a depth buffer reads the target on PanVK with a Bifrost GPU
- GS/Vulkan: keep game depth without stencil on PanVK with a Bifrost GPU
- GS/Vulkan: open render passes over their draws on PanVK with a Bifrost GPU
- arm64: the IOP recompiler uses the per-page block index
- arm64: FindByHostPc's comment says again that the walk only reads, takes no locks and allocates nothing
- arm64: BlockPageIndex header carries the ARMSX2 Contributors copyright line
- EE arm64: reduce JIT block-index insertion stalls
- GS: the fused-layout comments name the layouts and counts that are there now
- tests: the {RGBAQ, XYZF2} pair through Transfer, draw buffering, the mid-record resume and a draw start
- tests: the NOP-padded {ST, RGBAQ, XYZ2} triple under a moving environment and at a draw start
- GS: Fuse {RGBAQ, XYZF2} packed tags in the vertex kernel
- GS: Fuse NOP-padded ST/RGBAQ/XYZ2 triangle strips
- FullscreenUI: show AM or PM on the 12-hour clock in locales without AM/PM text
- FullscreenUI: regenerate the translation string block
- FullscreenUI: add a clock format setting for the menu clocks
- Android: ignore cluster_cpus_list in the app's cpuinfo copy when the cluster id is unknown
- 3rdparty/cpuinfo: ignore cluster_cpus_list when the cluster id is unknown
- libretro: apply the Multitap option at startup only
- libretro: add a Multitap option
- libretro: send rumble to the pad's libretro port
- libretro: read input from every controller port
- GS: force-inline three lambdas with the attribute, not __forceinline
- Android: offer the newest ARMSX2 GPU driver once after each app update
- iOS: drop the launch trigger that builds a report
- iOS: drop the perf telemetry and simulator no-JIT switches
- vtlb: drop the iPSX2_FORCE_NO_FASTMEM switch
- iOS: build the runtime with ARC
- iOS: split SceneDelegate.mm into the VM thread and AirPlay files
- iOS: rename ios_main.mm to IOSRuntime.mm and split out three files
- iOS: split GamepadHaptics.mm by concern
- iOS: take the settings lock in the runtime and honour Haptic Feedback
- USB: Scale Trance Vibrator intensity to 0-1
- SDL frontend: turn the picture for a panel mounted sideways on bare KMS
- Android: regenerate the PGO profile on the release source, with one game on the software renderer
- vtlb: reserve a guard after the fastmem window and backpatch faults in it
- tests: EE fastmem fault reported at the end of the 4 GB window
- common: a syscall a seccomp filter traps returns ENOSYS instead of killing the process
- tests: the IOP thread under a seccomp filter that traps membarrier
- tests: the short-run texture model hands an open group to the ordinary calls at a flush
- GS/Vulkan: recording the waiting run groups leaves set 1 as the device says
- GS/Vulkan: a short run pushes only the textures its groups read
- msvc: list the pad script and the new GS headers
- GS/Vulkan: the run emitter's copyright line matches the other files
- GS/Vulkan: remove the run emitter's process-wide counters
- GS: remove the row and vertex-fact records nothing writes
- GS/HW: a device loss closes the row run
- GS/Vulkan: a texture leaving the device records the waiting run groups first
- GS/Vulkan: a grown vertex ring records the waiting run groups before it is bound
- tests: after a device loss a GPU palette read uses only the new device's textures
- GS: a device loss releases everything the renderer holds from the old device
- tests: after a device loss the new device is handed only objects it created
- GS/Vulkan: a draw that declares its own feedback loop is not a run group
- GS/Vulkan: a run of one or two groups takes the ordinary calls
- GS/Vulkan: held twins join the driver's run entry
- GS/Vulkan: hand runs of TFX draws to the driver's run entry where it has one
- GS/Vulkan: on the Adreno 650 under Turnip a run group samples at most four textures through the sampler
- tests: run rows on the Adreno 650 under Turnip are bounded on the sampler and fetch when small
- GS/Vulkan: run streak classes take the targets by their sizes, not their addresses
- tests: a run streak's class does not depend on where the host put the targets
- GS/Vulkan: an in-pass readback kick begins the open pass again on the same targets
- GS/Vulkan: the row emitter's decisions do not depend on the in-pass kick
- GS/HW: copy runs: cheaper per-copy checks
- GS/HW: copy runs, a palette block copy that continues the last one skips Draw()
- GS: a class opens its group at the first row when its own streaks predict break-even
- GS: tests of a class's opening length predicted from its own streaks, failing
- GS/Vulkan: a row that changes nothing about its group skips the group's checks
- GS/Vulkan: held twins recorded back to back bind only what differs
- GS: tests of what a raw-recorded draw must bind after the one before it, failing
- GS/Vulkan: the emitter classifies a row only when a group is open or would open
- GS/Vulkan: a group that replaces one ended at a ring or the texture cap needs its own program
- GS/Vulkan: the emitter asks RowIsPlain once a row, and smaller fixes
- GS: each side of the emitter remembers its own streak lengths

Full changelog: https://github.com/ARMSX2/ARMSX2/compare/nightly-20261121...63703376113cb1de711be66c687a21eb0a98a4a5
